chapter_theme: The three turiyas: the soul's turiya, the Supreme's turiya and Siva's turiya, each traced through waking and the states below it, answer to the three words of tvam tat asi. Standing in turiya the soul reaches the Lord beyond reach, leaves the thirty-six tattvas and maya by grace, and Nandi gives the true reality.
structure_note: 2466 sets out the three turiyas and their match with the three padas; 2467 to 2469 and 2472 to 2473 work through the states in each; 2470 and 2471 turn from the scheme to the practice and its fruit.

2466.reading: In the three states from waking is the soul's turiya; in the three from his own is the Supreme's turiya; in the three from waking is Siva's turiya; these together match the padas of tvam tat asi.
2466.nuance: The scheme is technical: each turiya is reached through its own triad of waking, dream and sleep, and the three are traditionally matched with தொம் (the soul), தத் (the Supreme) and அசி (their union).

2467.reading: Turiya in one's own waking is one's tvam-pada; the same turiya runs through waking and the other two; the unending supreme pada is beyond; and in the three higher states, like the sky, Siva's turiya draws near.
2467.nuance: ஆனாப் பரபதம் அற்றது அருநனா is obscure and the reading of line 3 is a guess. வானான மேல் மூன்று, the upper three that are sky, are taken as the higher grades of the states.

2468.reading: The four states in the soul's turiya, and the four practised in the Supreme's turiya, ripening into the Supreme that does not abate, meet at the node of turiya, and combined they make five.
2468.nuance: The arithmetic (four, four, five) depends on how the states are counted; கணு, node or joint, is taken as the point where the soul's states meet the Supreme's. The sense is unclear.

2469.reading: Go straight along the path through the ten states within the three turiyas to their end, and in the union with the Supreme that is the end of all, join the two halves into one end.
2469.nuance: ஈர்ஐந்து அவத்தை, ten states, are traditionally the five lower and five pure states. இரு பாதி, the two halves, may be the soul and the Supreme or the tvam and tat of the saying.

2470.reading: Hold fast to the ground of turiya; though the Lord seems out of reach, standing there you reach him, and when he is known as he truly is, the lips no longer meet to recite: that is the truth of it.
2470.nuance: பன்னா உதடுகள் தட்டாது, lips that do not strike together, is read as silence or as the mantra repeated without the lips moving. எட்டாது எனின் நின்று எட்டும் plays on reaching what does not reach.

2471.reading: Those devotees on the path who knew the thirty-six as unreal before knowledge and left them, and broke dense maya by grace, came to know the state that becomes the great grace never parted.
2471.nuance: அசத்து is the Siddhanta term for what is inert and passing, set against the conscious soul. Here the breaking of maya is by grace, and the knowers are அன்பர், those who love.

2472.reading: As the fourth, turiya, becoming the waking within waking, is the soul's tvam-pada, so for the soul freed of deeds, becoming waking and the rest, the Supreme's turiya is the tat-pada.
2472.nuance: தெம்பதம் is read as தொம்பதம். The verse makes the two padas parallel grades of the same scheme: the soul's turiya for tvam, the Supreme's for tat, reached by the soul freed of deeds.

2473.reading: As tvam-pada and tat-pada are named as turiyas, the good name belongs to the trusted third turiya; beyond the moon and beyond the very subtle, glorious Nandi, the true reality, took me and gave grace.
2473.nuance: The third turiya is the asi of the saying, the union. அம்புலி உன்னா, not thinking the moon, is taken as beyond the moon of the yogic body. செம்பொருள், the true reality, is a word the Kural also uses.

links.note: 2466 matches the three turiyas with the three padas; 2488 restates it as soul, Supreme and Siva appearing in turiya as tvam tat asi.
Both name the goal செம்பொருள். For the Kural, seeing it is the work of knowledge that ends birth; for Tirumular, Nandi as the true reality takes him and gives it by grace.

source_issues: Chapter title reads முத்திரியம், probably for முத்துரியம் (the three turiyas), which is what the verses treat.
2467 line 3 (ஆனாப் பரபதம் அற்றது அருநனா) is obscure and may be corrupt.
